violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. An employee certified in food safety management must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. New Violation. Correct By: 09/04/2026

Molluscan Shellfish (clams) located in prep unit #3 did not have the proper identification tags. Molluscan Shellstock tags must remain attached to/with the container in which the Molluscan Shellstock are received/stored until the container is empty/lot is gone. Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Service call placed. 3-bay sink must be used to sanitize until proper concentration of chlorine in dishwasher is reached/maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Ambient temperature of walk-in cooler observed at 47 degrees F. Foods in this unit observed with temperatures of 42 - 44 degrees F. Service call had been placed prior to inspection due to freezing of the compressor fan unit/piping. Foods were relocated to properly functioning 2-door reach-in units. TCS foods must remain at/below 41 degrees F. No TCS foods are to be stored in walk-in cooler until it is maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Working containers of dry ingredients/spices are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026
Spoons observed stored in stagnant water. Utensils must be stored in a clean, dry location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026
Cutting boards of the prep units on the cook/grill line observed to be very scratched and scored. Cutting boards must be resurfaced or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026
Leak observed at the dishwasher. Plumbing must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/04/2026

Rosa sauce, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Sauce was prepared yesterday. Temperature observed at 43 degrees F. Cooling logs are to be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 08/14/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Rosa sauce was placed hot in the refrigerator in a container greater than four inches deep. Temperature observed to be 43 degrees F. Proper cooling methods reviewed. Cooling logs are to be maintained. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/14/2025

Cutting boards are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of brown/black residue and other debris. Ice machine must be cleaned. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/14/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. An employee certified in food safety management must register with RIDOH and the Certified Food Safety Manager. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025
The hand-washing sinks in the kitchen were lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2025

Service call was placed during inspection. 3-bay sink is to be used to sanitize until dishwasher is serviced and achieving proper chlorine concentration. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2025
The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025
Spray bottles used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Clam sauce was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Proper cooling methods reviewed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2025

Thermometers are lacking in the refrigeration unit(s). All cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2025

Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of black/brown residue and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/18/2025

New Violation. Correct By: 10/31/2024
